create_streaming_lstm: create a RawStreamingLSTM module with a given dimension and number of layers
init_streaming_state: initialize the streaming state for a RawStreamingLSTM with a specified batch size
forward_lstm: run a forward pass through the RawStreamingLSTM on a torch tensor input
reset_lstm_state: reset the previous hidden and cell states in a _StreamingLSTMState dataclass
check_streamable: check whether a _StreamingLSTMState instance is currently streamable
